info.name: OpenRegister operations, import previews, audit, notifications, search trails and deleted objects
info.description:
API coverage for the operations console (console, jobs, rule runs, runs, run-now, schedule, alerts), operations consistency (check, repair plan, repair), operations maintenance (maintenance mode, support bundle, facts), import previews (policies, list, create, show, rows, commit), audit trails (v1 and v2 query/export), the notification surfaces (history, subscriptions, preferences, templates, broadcasts, group preferences, delivery window), search trails and deleted objects.

Each route is asserted on its success path, its unknown-id and invalid-input answers where the controller validates, and its access answer: admin-only routes are refused to a non-admin by the framework, and every refused write is followed by a re-read proving nothing changed.

SELF-SEEDING. The 00 setup folder creates its own non-admin user (OCS provisioning API), register, schema and object, keyed on a random run id; 99 teardown deletes them. Settings a request changes (job schedule, alert threshold, maintenance mode, notification preferences) are restored within the same folder. It depends on no other collection.
